items.title: Angus Taylor resigns from frontbench ahead of expected leadership challenge
items.description: Angus Taylor says the Liberals are at their weakest point since the party was formed as he announces his resignation from the frontbench.

items.title: Boy's Triple Zero call to save family swept out to sea released
items.description: Police release the recording of the Triple Zero call made by 13-year-old Austin Appelbee after his marathon 4 kilometre swim through rough seas to save his family.

items.title: PM 'not contemplating failure' as Closing the Gap deadline looms
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is bullish on closing the gap between Indigenous and non-Indigenous people ahead of handing down his annual report card on the progress made.

items.title: Live: Aussie Anthony fails to defend Olympic moguls crown
items.description: Australia's defending champion Jakara Anthony finishes eighth after slipping during her second run of the women's moguls super final at the Winter Olympics. Follow live.

items.title: A woman killed nine people in rare mass shooting in Canada. Here's what we know
items.description: Police confirmed the suspect was a woman but have yet to identify the victims of the mass shooting that left 10 people, including the alleged shooter, dead in the rural town.

items.title: Names of six 'powerful men' scrubbed from Epstein files revealed by US politician
items.description: US politician Ro Khanna has publicly named six men whose identities were scrubbed from the Epstein files, including the former boss of Victoria's Secret, who the FBI suspected was a co-conspirator of the sex offender's crimes.

items.title: Fresh video shows police pushing protester before fight broke out
items.description: A new video filmed by a bystander and shared with ABC NEWS Verify shows the full minute before two police officers began punching a protester, shedding light on the beginning of the altercation.

items.title: Labor tries again on super taxes, but success will hinge on Greens support
items.description: A second attempt to raise taxes on high super balances has been presented to parliament, but will require the support of the Greens to secure Senate passage.

items.title: Buildings in flooded NT town become 'their own individual islands'
items.description: Floodwaters have spilled inside "quite a number of homes" in the remote Northern Territory town of Daly River, authorities say, with still-rising water levels delaying the return home for evacuated locals.

items.title: Fatberg responsible for foul-smelling debris balls is 'inaccessible' for Sydney Water
items.description: The debris balls that have washed up on NSW beaches in recent years are likely to continue as Sydney Water admits a massive fatberg it cannot reach is clogging sewers.

items.title: Injured e-bike rider's warning after spending nine days in coma
items.description: More than 200 people were treated for e-bike related injuries at a single Sydney hospital last year, with one medical professor describing the trend as an "epidemic".

items.title: Surveillance devices captured accused talking about alleged murder, court hears
items.description: An SA Supreme Court trial hears listening devices captured alleged murderer Mark Murphy admitting to his role in killing Geoffrey McLean in 2022. Warning: This story contains details that some readers may find distressing.

items.title: Australia cruises to victory over Ireland in T20 World Cup opener
items.description: Australia beats Ireland by 67 runs to win its first game at the T20 World Cup, after captain Mitch Marsh was a late out due to testicular bleeding.

items.title: A timeline of the investigation into Nancy Guthrie's kidnapping
items.description: As the frantic search for the mother of a well-known US journalist enters its 12th day, police have more questions than answers. Here's how it unfolded.

items.title: 'Gimme more': Britney sells rights to music catalogue in reported $281m deal
items.description: Spears is the latest music star to sell the rights to their work, and comes a decade after the release of her ninth and last studio album.

items.title: Channel Nine says Warren Tredrea has now paid legal costs
items.description: Channel Nine has confirmed it has received legal costs from former AFL player and sports presenter Warren Tredrea, who was ordered to pay $149,000 to his ex-employer.

items.title: The Muppet 50th birthday special makes the case for a new season
items.description: Kermit, Miss Piggy and the rest of the crew are back to celebrate their 50th birthday with a one-off special that has the potential to turn into a whole new series for the beloved characters.

items.title: Telstra to axe up to 650 roles in mass redundancy round
items.description: Telstra notifies staff of plans to outsource hundreds of jobs to an India-based technology company.

items.title: Israeli president welcomes 'new beginning' in meeting with Albanese
items.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog meets with the prime minister at Parliament House in Canberra, saying his visit to Australia has been "very emotional".

items.title: Court hears alleged sexual offender allowed to work alone with children after complaints
items.description: A North Queensland parents association is fined $50,000 for failures in handling allegations of sexual abuse at an after school care service.

items.title: Children at 'imminent' kidnapping risk by man who built secret loft in his home
items.description: WA Police say "something terrible" could have happened if there was a delay in intercepting a Baldivis man who planned to abduct and sexually abuse a child in Perth.

items.title: 'You have not gotten away with anything': NSW MPs back Cheryl Grimmer motion
items.description: Decades after three-year-old Cheryl Grimmer vanished from Fairy Meadow Beach, NSW MPs move to support her family's fight for justice, as Jeremy Buckingham directly addressed the alleged perpetrator under parliamentary privilege.

items.title: Aussie fans miss out on World Cup tickets as prices skyrocket
items.description: A host of Australian fans will be denied the chance to watch the Socceroos World Cup campaign amid accusations of price gouging by FIFA as tickets to the tournament soar to astronomical prices.

items.title: Australian dollar and yen at a level not seen since the 80s
items.description: Australia's exchange rate with Japan has grown increasingly favourable to tourists, which have surged to record numbers and topped more than one million visitors in 2025.

items.title: US statement accuses Palau senate president of taking bribes from China
items.description: A senior Palau politician rejects accusations from the United States Department of State that he accepted bribes from "government, business, and criminal interests from China".
